The metadata describing the contents of a [`components.ImageBuffer`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/image_buffer).

## Fields
#### `width`
Type: non-null `UInt32`

The width of the image in pixels.

#### `height`
Type: non-null `UInt32`

The height of the image in pixels.

#### `pixel_format`
Type: [`PixelFormat`](../encodings/pixel_format.md)

Used mainly for chroma downsampled formats and differing number of bits per channel.

If specified, this takes precedence over both [`encodings.ColorModel`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/encodings/color_model?speculative-link) and [`encodings.ChannelDatatype`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/encodings/channel_datatype?speculative-link) (which are ignored).

#### `color_model`
Type: [`ColorModel`](../encodings/color_model.md)

L, RGB, RGBA, …

Also requires a [`encodings.ChannelDatatype`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/encodings/channel_datatype?speculative-link) to fully specify the pixel format.

#### `channel_datatype`
Type: [`ChannelDatatype`](../encodings/channel_datatype.md)

The data type of each channel (e.g. the red channel) of the image data (U8, F16, …).

Also requires a [`encodings.ColorModel`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/encodings/color_model?speculative-link) to fully specify the pixel format.
